people.name: Pimienta
people.role: Dog, ring bearer (handler TBC by client)

seating.notes: R4: Aino-Kaarina seated directly next to Päivikki in the front row; seats physically reserved with signs and ushers briefed. Exact left-to-right order to be confirmed with the client and chapel layout. Check step-free access to chapel and olive grove and ask about a buggy. At dinner seat her within sight of the speeches but away from the DJ speakers. R13: the event date 2026-09-12 is before the system date (2026-10-13); the client must confirm the date, and nothing is booked, signed or paid until written client approval (and date confirmation) is received.

photographer: TBC - not Lumière Fotografia (R6); at least two alternative quotes to be sourced, with written date exclusivity and a named backup photographer
venue_notes: R13: Date unconfirmed (system date is after the event date). No bookings, contracts or deposits without written client approval.

R5: Nut-free (no almonds in the cake) must be written into the caterer's contract, with written confirmation covering kitchen, suppliers, cake baker, cross-contamination and 'may contain' products. Check almond desserts, marzipan, nougat, pesto, amaretto/orgeat, nut oils. A nephew carries an EpiPen. Staff briefed, dishes labelled, caterer names an allergen lead. Menu dishes not yet supplied.
R5: Children's meal count pending from the client; 0 is a placeholder, not a real count.

R3/R20: Ask the quinta about chapel PA/mics; if none, quote a headset or lapel mic for Päivikki plus a spare, and a sound check at 14:45. Confirm her fee, meals, dinner speeches and consecutive vs whispered interpretation.

R9/R16: If the IPMA forecast max exceeds 32C, cocktails move to the wine cellar. Provisional call Wed 9 Sept, final Fri 11 Sept by 12:00, client approves. Confirm cellar capacity for ~96, cooling, caterer serving both layouts and switch time. Both layouts priced and staffed. Fans and water at the chapel.
R11/R15: If the ceremony starts late, shorten cocktails (minimum 60 minutes), never the ceremony. Dinner at 19:30 is fixed. Brief caterer and DJ.
R12: Tell the quinta Pimienta is the ring bearer. Ask about pet rules and fees and a waiting area. Kitchen and food areas dog-free. Handler TBC by client.

R14: Run of show to be checked with the quinta: 14:30 vendor setup; 14:45 sound check; 15:00 first shuttle; 15:45 seated; 16:00 ceremony; 17:15 cocktails; 19:20 to tables; 19:30 dinner; ~22:45 dancing; ~01:00 music ends (check noise curfew); shuttles from ~midnight, last 01:30.
R17: Shuttle quote for 96 guests plus couple's party; hotel(s), travel time and guest split pending.
R18: Fireworks are optional (EUR 1,500, first to cut) and pending client decision. If wanted, check permits, September rural fire-risk restrictions and the effect on the dog.
R8: Get the printer's last-order date to set the RSVP cut-off; Finnish cards only if more than 25 of Eero's family confirm.
R7: Add a do-not-play clause for Macarena to the DJ contract/rider.

R10/R19: Budget is a hard cap of EUR 42,000; placeholders sum to exactly EUR 42,000 including EUR 2,600 contingency. Any quote that pushes the total over the cap must be reported. No vendor quotes have been received yet.

R21: Open client questions: date, children numbers and ages, Eero's family confirmations, sign-off authority, hotel and guests staying, mobility needs, anything already paid or booked, Pimienta's handler, fireworks, other dietary needs.
